### **1.1 Title & Overview**

**Does the title slide include all required identification information?**

The title slide should explicitly include:

* Company name: Alphabet Inc.
* Fiscal period: Quarter ended March 31, 2024
* Announcement date: April 25, 2024
* A short sentiment sub-header summarizing overall performance (e.g., “Alphabet Announces First Quarter 2024 Results”)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which required element(s) are missing.

**Is there a clearly identifiable Executive Summary part immediately following the title?**

The Executive Summary should:

* Present high-level top-line figures (Revenues: $80.5 billion, Operating Income: $25.5 billion)
* Include Net Income ($23.7 billion) and Diluted EPS ($1.89)
* Explicitly distinguish GAAP growth vs. Constant Currency growth (15% vs 16% revenue growth)
* Include year-over-year percentage changes (e.g., Net Income up 57%)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which metrics or distinctions are missing.

**Is there a dedicated slide(s) presenting management commentary?**

This slide should:

* Include at least one quote from Sundar Pichai (on the Gemini era and momentum in AI research and infrastructure)
* Include at least one quote from Ruth Porat (on revenue strength and efforts to durably reengineer the cost base)
* Attribute quotes clearly to the speaker

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which executive perspective is missing.

**Does the leadership commentary clearly serve a strategic or narrative purpose?**

The slide should frame:

* How leadership explains performance drivers (e.g., strong performance from Search, YouTube, and Cloud)
* Why the company's global product footprint positions it well for the next wave of AI innovation

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, describe how the narrative context is unclear or absent.

**Is there a slide summarizing income statement highlights year-over-year?**

The slide should cover:

* Revenues ($80.5 billion)
* Operating Income ($25.5 billion)
* Net Income ($23.7 billion)
* Diluted EPS ($1.89)
* Comparison with the quarter ended March 31, 2023

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which financial elements are missing.

**Are GAAP and non-GAAP figures visually and explicitly distinguished?**

This distinction should be clear through:

* Labels or tables showing "Constant Currency" reconciliation
* Exclusion of specific charges (e.g., severance and related charges, office space charges) to show underlying performance
* Clear explanation of the impact of these charges on operating income and margin

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, explain where the distinction is unclear.

**Is capital return to shareholders (including the new dividend policy) explicitly covered?**

The slides should mention:

* The initiation of a cash dividend ($0.20 per share)
* The new $70 billion share repurchase authorization
* The total amount of share repurchases during the quarter ($15.7 billion)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify what aspect of capital allocation is missing.

**Is there a dedicated section covering all major business segments?**

The slides should separately cover:

* Google Services (Search, YouTube, etc.)
* Google Cloud
* Other Bets

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which segment(s) are missing.

**For each segment, are revenue and operating income figures presented?**

Each segment should include:

* Total segment revenue (e.g., Google Cloud: $9.6 billion)
* Operating income or loss (e.g., Google Cloud operating income of $900 million)
* Year-over-year growth or margin improvement

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which quantitative elements are missing for which segment.

**Are key product-level revenue highlights listed?**

Expected coverage includes:

* Google Search & other ($46.2 billion)
* YouTube ads ($8.1 billion)
* Google Network ($7.4 billion)
* Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices ($8.7 billion)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which products or services are omitted.

**Is there a slide summarizing operational efficiency or headcount?**

This slide should:

* Mention the company's ongoing efforts to durably reengineer the cost base
* Reflect headcount changes (e.g., 180,895 employees vs 190,711 in the prior year)
* Mention the impact of workforce reductions and office space optimization

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, describe what operational context is missing.

**Is there information regarding future outlook or investment focus?**

The content should:

* Mention leadership in AI research and infrastructure
* Discuss momentum across the company's product footprint
* Note the focus on delivering value for shareholders through dividends and repurchases

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify what focus areas are missing.

**Is there a slide addressing forward-looking statements and risks?**

This slide should:

* State that statements are based on current expectations and involve risks and uncertainties
* Reference factors that could cause actual results to differ (e.g., competition, AI development, legal/regulatory matters)
* Direct the audience to the company's SEC filings (Form 10-K, 10-Q)

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, explain what disclaimer content is missing.

**Is there information provided for the investor relations contact?**

The slide should include:

* Link to the investor relations website (abc.xyz/investor)
* Contact information for Investor Relations and Media
* Details about the earnings webcast

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which closing information is absent.

**Does the slide deck include all required major sections in the prescribed order?**

Required sections include:

1. Title & Overview
2. Leadership Context
3. Financial Deep Dive
4. Segment Performance
5. Operational Highlights
6. Closing & Disclaimers

  Note: You only need to check whether the slides contain the required contents; you do not need to verify their correctness.
  If **no**, specify which section is missing, reordered, or merged incorrectly.
